Repository: https://github.com/WerWolv/libtesla
Commit: f766e9b607a05e9756843cbd62b3bfb98be1646c
Files vendored: include/tesla.hpp, include/stb_truetype.h, LICENSE
Local support header: include/playwise_glyph_cache.hpp (not an upstream file).
Local compatibility patch: tesla.hpp replaces its sole dynamic_cast with a
List-parent static_cast so the overlay can honor -fno-rtti.
Local Device Lab patch: defining TESLA_FORCE_CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED_FONT makes the
internal forensic overlay load Nintendo's Simplified Chinese shared font even
when the console language is not Chinese. Normal overlay builds do not define it.
Local correctness patch: List focus traversal uses an underflow-safe reverse
loop for its unsigned focused index.
Local PlayWise font patch: load both Nintendo Chinese shared fonts, select each
glyph from the available faces, and include the chosen language in the glyph
cache key. This supports Simplified and Traditional UI text on either system
language without changing the upstream commit recorded above.
Local overlay memory patch: restrict emoji font search to overlay-specific paths
and cap maximum file size to 256KB to prevent ovlloader 4MB heap exhaustion.
Local resource patch (2026-10-13): fixed metadata for at most 512 cached glyphs,
256KiB bitmap budget, pre-allocation eviction, owning bitmap deleters and
renderer-exit cleanup. Transparent text measurement never rasterizes a glyph.
PlayWise defines TESLA_DISABLE_EMOJI_FONT to skip unused SD font loading.
Local lifecycle patch (2026-10-13): atomic cross-thread flags, UI-thread-only
hide handling, input snapshots outside IPC/SD work, and event lifetime spanning
thread startup through join. Parse settings on the main thread before starting
the 4KiB-stack input poller. The pinned upstream commit remains unchanged.
Local PlayWise detail cooperation patch (2026-11-11): optional UI-thread hidden
poll and post-render callbacks. Default overlays still wait indefinitely.
PlayWise polls at 250ms when enabled, 5s when disabled (2026-11-12; the interval comes from
companion/overlay/hidden_poll.h, tesla.hpp itself is unchanged); HOME/POWER blocks automatic wake until a manual
combo. Hidden input snapshots are copied under the mutex; SD work is outside it.
No new services, cross-process loader calls, manager replacement or HID injection.
Local idle power patch (2026-11-11): input polling waits 50ms while hidden with
no buttons held, 20ms while visible or holding buttons. HOME/POWER-blocked hidden
UI waits indefinitely for the manual combo event. Local support header:
include/playwise_poll_policy.hpp. Upstream commit remains pinned as above.
Local resident brief patch (2026-11-14): optional UI-thread hidden-frame callback.
A drawn hidden frame keeps bounded polling long enough to clear on HOME/POWER.
The callback receives a copied button-down snapshot and never requests foreground.
PlayWise reads only its exact-byte reason/test journal targets, retains publisher
cleanup ownership and draws on the existing framebuffer. No upstream files synced.
Local resident suppression follow-up (2026-11-14): HOME/POWER signals wake the
existing combo event so the UI thread clears any hidden frame immediately, then
returns to blocked idle without foreground acquisition. Manual combo retains
its existing unblock behavior. Upstream commit remains unchanged.
Local resident rendering patch: only submit a hidden frame when a brief appears,
changes or clears; the front buffer presents the static notice between events.
The brief dismissal cadence does not speed up automatic detail file polling.
Local notification wake patch: the hidden UI can also wait on a readable IPC
event. The combo event wins when both are ready, HOME/POWER blocks the optional
event, and wait errors return to timed file polling. Upstream commit unchanged.
